import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
p=pathlib.Path("udt_gw_response_robustness_design_campaign")
git=["git","-c","core.preloadIndex=false","-c","index.threads=1"]
call=lambda *a:subprocess.check_output(git+list(a),text=True)
r=subprocess.run(git+["diff","--cached","--check"],capture_output=True,text=True)
expected={"FINAL_REVIEW.md":199,"INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_NOTES.md":131,"INITIAL_REVIEW.md":56,"REVIEW_RESULT.json":63,"SOURCE_FIRST_SEAL.md":131,"TRAINING_BOUND_NOTE.md":36,"independent_arm_integral.py":51,"independent_definitions.py":167,"independent_target.py":131,"replay_and_catches.py":58}
want={str(p/"step_01/review"/name)+":"+str(line)+": new blank line at EOF." for name,line in expected.items()}
assert r.returncode==2 and set(r.stdout.splitlines())==want and len(r.stdout.splitlines())==10 and r.stderr==""
manifest={}
for line in (p/"SHA256SUMS").read_text().splitlines():
 h,name=line.split("  ",1)
 assert name not in manifest
 assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,name
 manifest[name]=h
for name in expected:
 q=p/"step_01/review"/name
 assert hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==manifest[str(q)]
review_entries={}
for name in ["REVIEW_MANIFEST.tsv","PACKAGING_MANIFEST.tsv"]:
 rows=(p/"step_01/review"/name).read_text().splitlines()
 assert rows[0].lower().startswith("sha256"),rows[0]
 count=0
 for row in rows[1:]:
  h,f=row.split("\t")
  assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,f
  count+=1
 review_entries[name]=count
files={str(q) for q in p.rglob("*") if q.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in q.parts and q.suffix!=".pyc"}
staged=set(call("diff","--cached","--name-only").splitlines())
tracking={"LIVE.md","HANDOFF.md","CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md"}
assert staged==files|tracking
exclusions={str(p/"SHA256SUMS")}|{str(p/("manifest_check"+s)) for s in [".json",".stdout",".stderr"]}
assert set(manifest)==staged-exclusions
assert not call("diff","--name-only").strip()
names=sorted(x for x in call("status","--short").splitlines() if x.startswith("?? "))
nh=hashlib.sha256("\n".join(names).encode()).hexdigest()
assert len(names)==46 and nh=="d65d71d63a56b95aabfd61f33317b1f1f2b2a62a85ded8258c525b99a5e156ea"
print(json.dumps(dict(scope="exact staged allowlist, manifest correspondence and preserved whitespace audit; not science review",normal_cached_whitespace_returncode=r.returncode,raw_whitespace_stdout=r.stdout,raw_whitespace_stderr=r.stderr,disposition="EXACT10 DOCUMENTED EOF EXCEPTIONS, not ordinary whitespace PASS",manifest_entries=len(manifest),manifest_excludes_self_and_post_manifest_receipts=sorted(exclusions),review_manifest_entries=review_entries,staged_authorized_files=len(staged),unstaged_tracked_changes=False,unrelated_untracked_count=len(names),unrelated_name_hash=nh,protected_payload_contents_inspected=False,post_audit_receipts="This audit adds only staging_audit.json/stdout/stderr after checking; these self-referential receipts are explicitly outside SHA256SUMS and will be staged separately"),indent=2))
